blocks.content: In the Can I Use? tool, hovering over each colored box provides detailed compatibility information for CSS features across browsers. Here's a quick guide to the values you might see:
Once you hover over a box, you'll see one of the following values:

rows: The CSS feature works perfectly in the listed browsers without extra code. You can use it confidently.
The feature works but has some limitations or missing functionality. You might need extra code to handle these issues.
Some browsers need a special prefix (like -webkit-) for the feature to work, often in older versions or for experimental features.
The feature doesn't work at all in certain browsers. You may need to find an alternative or provide a fallback.

blocks.content: Use these values to decide which CSS features to implement in your design.
